name: IHG One Rewards Traveler Credit Card

localized_names.en: IHG One Rewards Traveler Credit Card

apr.notes: 19.24% to 27.74% variable APR. APR is Min of (Prime + 12.49%) and 29.99% to Min of (Prime + 20.99%) and 29.99%.

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees when you use your card for purchases made outside the United States.

base_rate.description: Earn 2X points per $1 spent on all other purchases.

categories.label: Purchases at hotels participating in IHG One Rewards
Utilities; internet, cable and phone services; select streaming services; dining at restaurants (including takeout and eligible delivery); and gas stations

rewards.redemption_notes: Redeem points for free nights at IHG Hotels and Resorts. Redeem 3 nights, get 4th night free on consecutive four-night stays. Free nights at 4,700+ IHG properties globally.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 80,000 Bonus Points after you spend $2,000 on purchases in the first 3 months from account opening. Plus, earn 10,000 bonus points after you add an authorized user in the first 3 months.

benefits.title: Automatic Silver Elite Status
benefits.description: Automatic Silver Elite Status as long as you remain an IHG One Rewards Traveler Cardmember.

benefits.title: 10,000 Annual Bonus Points
benefits.description: Earn 10,000 bonus points after you spend $10,000 each calendar year.

benefits.title: Redeem 3 Nights, Get 4th Night Free
benefits.description: When you redeem points for a consecutive four-night IHG hotel stay, you can receive a fourth Reward Night free redeemable at that same hotel during that same stay.

benefits.title: Gold Elite Status
benefits.description: Each calendar year you make purchases totaling $20,000 or more, you, as the primary cardmember, will qualify for Gold Elite Status through December 31st of the following year.

benefits.title: Save 20% on Rewards Points Purchases
benefits.description: Save 20% when you purchase points with your IHG One Rewards Traveler credit card.

benefits.title: Early Access to IHG Reward Night Sales
benefits.description: As an IHG One Rewards Cardmember, you are eligible for early access to Reward Night sales each year.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: You will pay no foreign transaction fees when you use your card for purchases made outside the United States.

benefits.title: Baggage Delay Insurance
benefits.description: Reimburses you up to $100 a day for up to 3 days for essential purchases like toiletries and clothing when baggage is delayed over 6 hours.

benefits.title: Lost Luggage Reimbursement
benefits.description: Provides reimbursement up to $3,000 per covered traveler for the cost to repair or replace checked or carry-on baggage that is lost, damaged or stolen during a covered trip.

benefits.title: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers your eligible new purchases for 120 days from the date of purchase against damage or theft up to $500 per item.

benefits.title: Trip Cancellation and Interruption Insurance
benefits.description: If your trip is canceled or cut short by sickness, severe weather or other covered situations, you can be reimbursed up to $5,000 per covered traveler and $10,000 per trip for your pre-paid, non-refundable travel expenses.

benefits.title: DoorDash DashPass
benefits.description: Get one-year complimentary DashPass, membership for both DoorDash and Caviar. Activate by Dec 31, 2027.

benefits.title: Instacart Credit
benefits.description: Receive a monthly $10 Instacart credit, up to $120 annually, plus a complimentary 3-month Instacart+ membership. Benefits end 12/31/27.

travel_perks.hotel_status: Automatic Silver Elite Status; Gold Elite after $20,000 annual spend
other: Fourth Night Free on reward stays

notes: Verified from official Chase product page on 2026-07-25. Filled the 5X (IHG hotels) and 3X (utilities; internet/cable/phone; select streaming; dining including takeout/delivery; gas stations) bonus tiers, which were empty placeholders; base earn is 2X. Rewards currency corrected from ultimate_rewards to ihg_points. Network confirmed as Mastercard via the page's Mastercard/World Elite Mastercard trademark footnote; the no-annual-fee Traveler is a World Mastercard (World Elite is reserved for the Premier), so mastercard/world retained.
